name: tripwire
description: Rules that are enforced, not remembered: deny, ask, rewrite or note on any tool call, subagents included. An 8-bit trap for every mistake you already wrote down.

compileModel.title: Model for /tripwire add
compileModel.description: The model that turns a plain-English sentence into a proposed rule. The proposal is never armed until you press ARM.

band.title: TRAP SPRUNG band
band.description: Show a red band above the prompt when a deny rule fires.
